# Edge access logs

One file per day, nginx-style lines: ip, time, request, status, response bytes, latency.
/api/v2/orders and /api/v2/orders/export are different endpoints; count only the exact path asked about.

turns.prompt: Which request path produced the most 404s over the week in logs/edge?
